rule_counter_repeat.note: Same counter at the cap for asks up to 1.50 x cap, at most 3 rule counters per conversation (the 1.18 first counter included), then walk away without a model. over_budget_counter stays as it is.

first_message_conditions.note: Food orders only: by order hash, the share in the conditions arm state the order's accepted grades, needed hours of shelf life and certificate in the first message; the control arm sends today's message unchanged. Goods wording is unchanged. Missing, broken or not true means off.

goods_first_message_grades.note: Goods orders only: by order hash (its own salt), the share in the conditions arm add one sentence stating the order's accepted grades after 'I want to buy {item}.'; the certificate and warranty sentences and the control arm are unchanged. Missing, broken or not true means off.

retry_other_shop.note: One retry at another shop for an order the first shop lost, inside our run, to a quote with short shelf life or an unacceptable grade, or to a refusal at the first message. Refusals by the kit at payment come after our run returns and are never retried. Missing, broken or not true means off.
